translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', bi shanzle selall'le gakle beṉ' chli' chsedi, ḻa' ba ṉezkzile' kat' yizi' Chioza' cho' kwent wsak'zi'che' neto' chli' chsedinto' beṉ' shi bi gonnto' ka cheenile'.
Yog'ḻoḻcho chx̱iṉjcho. Na' beena' bi chx̱iṉje' de cho'a dill' nake' to beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', na' ḻekzka' chak iṉabi'e doxen kwerp c̱he'na'.
Kat' chgoocho dona' cho'a kabaya' kwenc̱he gom ka cheenicho, chzakicho chgoochob neza' gana' cheenicho shajb.
Na' ḻekzka' ḻi wwiakachi barkwka', ḻa'kzi nakgakan dii xen wal na' chde be' wala' chlligaan diika', beṉ'ka' chsa' ḻegakan chdagake' toz yagdo' xaninka' na' chajgakan gana' cheengakile'.
Ka'kzan chak c̱he ḻoll'choni. Ḻa'kzi nakan to diido'zə, dii zan dii chshalj chshonan. Ṉezicho toz bzeyi'do' wak wzeyan to yix̱' diṉ xen wal.
Na' ḻoll'choni nakan ka to yi'. Na' nakan to dii lliashesh' chiya dii mal na' chx̱iṉj chḻenan do ka nak beṉec̱ha' shlak mbane' daa chzenague' c̱he dii xiwaa.
Beṉec̱ha' chak gonmaxe' yog'te bayix̱', ka ba ze xan yabana', ka ba chx̱ob ḻe'in, ka ba yoo ḻoo nisdo'na'. Per ḻa'kzi chṉabi'e ḻegakb,
bi chak iṉabi'e ḻolleena'. Nakan to dii mal dii bi cheeni no iṉabia' ḻen, na' nakan ka yierb dii chitan beṉ'.
Chc̱hincho ḻoll'choni choe'la'ocho X̱acho Chioza', beena' nak X̱ancho, na' ḻekzka' chc̱hinchon chyishjcho bia' blag' c̱he beṉ'ka' bx̱e bsile', beṉ'ka' bene' lwaa lsakee.
Cho'a ḻoll'choni choe'la'olenchon Chioza' na' ḻekzka' ḻen chyishjan bia' blag' c̱he beṉ'. Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', bi chiyaḻ' goncho ka'.
To ga chal nis, aga wak galan nis dii gak yeejcho na' galten nis zxi'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ṉezile to yag yix̱wew aga wbian daa ne' aceituna, na' yag uvana' aga wak kwian yix̱wew. Na' ka'kzə gana' chal nis zxi'na' aga walan dii gak yeejcho.
Shi ladjlena' zoa beṉ' sin', beṉ' chajnii, chiyaḻ' wli'en wsa' c̱he' wen na' wḻex̱j yic̱hje' gone' kon ka na yeḻ' sin'na' daa noe' Chioza' ḻe'.
Na' shi we'le latj wx̱iṉj wḻen yeḻ' xe'na' yic̱hjlall'do'lena', na' gonile beṉ' nakzi, bi chiyaḻ' wshalj wshonle iṉale naple yeḻ' sin' daa choṉ Chioza'. Ḻa' shi ka' chonle aga dill' ḻin choe'le.
Ka nak yeḻ' sin'na' daa nale naple, bi nakan dii beṉ Chioza', san nakan de yell-liozə dii chalj yic̱hjlall'do'lena', na' nakten c̱he dii x̱iwaa.
Gana' zoa beṉ'ka' chakxe'i ljwellgake' na' chakdiḻgake' nogaken' mbejlawi, nan' chxe wdiḻ wishesh na' chiya dii mal.

Beṉ'ka' nap yeḻ' sin' daa choe' Chioza', nakgake' beṉ' chon ka cheenile', na' bi nakgake' beṉ' wishagdiḻ. Nakgake' beṉ' wen, beṉ' wizoa dill', beṉ' chiyesh'lallii beṉ', na' aga nakzi beṉ' chakgakile', na' nakgake' beṉ' chda do lallii.
Beṉ'ka' chon to dii byen soalen ljwellgake' mbalaz, na' ḻekzka' chongake' ka soalen ljwell beṉ' yoblə mbalaz, si'gake' banez goni beṉ' ḻegake' wen, na' soagake' mbalaz.
